description: Main program for reading and summarizing JESD216 flash memory parameters via SFDP, using Zephyr RTOS drivers.

methods.name: summarize_dw1
methods.description: Summarizes the first data word of the JESD216 BFP, including DTR clock support, addressing modes, and support for different modes.

methods.name: summarize_dw2
methods.description: Reports the flash density based on BFP data.

methods.name: summarize_dw89
methods.description: Summarizes erase types supported by the flash device.

methods.name: summarize_dw11
methods.description: Provides timing details for chip erase, byte programming, and page programming.

methods.name: summarize_dw14
methods.description: Details DPD (Deep Power-Down) support and instructions.

methods.name: summarize_dw15
methods.description: Reports hold/reset disable support, QER, and 0-4-4 mode sequences.

methods.name: summarize_dw16
methods.description: Reports support for 4-byte addressing, rescue sequences, and status register support.

methods.name: dump_bfp
methods.description: Outputs a summary of the Basic Flash Parameter (BFP) content.

methods.name: dump_bytes
methods.description: Outputs raw bytes of SFDP parameter data.
